cohort: The study included singleton pregnancies diagnosed with polyhydramnios who underwent cesarean delivery and had no fetal-placental-genetic or hematological diseases.
finding: Carbetocin was as effective as oxytocin in reducing postpartum hemorrhage during cesarean delivery for patients with polyhydramnios, and cases managed with carbetocin required fewer additional uterotonic drugs.
birth_weight: Recorded as a demographic characteristic, with fetal macrosomia noted as a secondary outcome.
